row.title: Average sensitivity
row.statement: The quantity is the universal coefficient \(C\) in \(\mathrm{AS}(f)\le Cd\sqrt n\) for polynomial threshold functions of degree at most \(d\), with \(1\le d\le n\) and \(\operatorname{sign}(0)=1\). A lower coefficient is better.

current.conditions: The paper rebuilds the compensated coupling argument of Lagdive, Aglave and Damre on OpenAI’s weighted filtration. That argument gives the coefficient \(8/\sqrt{2\pi}\approx3.1915\), and an exact rational certificate rounds it up to \(399/125\). The paper states it for all integers \(n,d\ge1\) with \(\operatorname{sgn}(0)=1\), and is dated October 17, 2026.
current.proofScope: No Lean proof is supplied for this result. The proof is the PDF paper in the repository; no independent check.
